title: Partner Program: Market Development Fund (MDF) Requests
author: Rachel Kim
body:
## Purpose
Resellers and SI partners sometimes write to Support asking for "credits" for joint marketing. Those are Market Development Funds (MDF), not billing credits.

## What Support does
- MDF requests are handled by Partnerships in the partner portal. Point the partner there; don't open a billing case.
- MDF is paid against approved campaign invoices from the partner. It never appears as a credit on a Redwood invoice and has no effect on the partner's usage bill.
- Partnerships approves MDF up to $5,000 per partner per quarter; larger requests go to the partner agreement owner.

## Not MDF
A partner asking about a charge on their own Redwood invoice is an ordinary billing question: follow the billing case routing page.

_Last reviewed 2027-02-02._
